body.zh: 针孔相机里，物点发出的光只有穿过小孔的那一条落到像平面上：像点在物点和小孔连成的直线上，横向位置 u = fX/Z。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 11）。常见的误解：像就落在和物点同样的横向位置上（u = X）。
body.en: In a pinhole camera only the ray through the hole reaches the image plane: the image of a point lies on the line through the point and the hole, at u = fX/Z. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 11). A common mistake: The image lands at the point's own lateral position (u = X).

body.zh: 物体的像高 h = fH/Z：和距离成反比，距离加倍，像缩成一半。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 9–11）。常见的误解：距离每多一点，像就少同样多一点（按差来减）。
body.en: An object's image height is h = fH/Z: inversely proportional to the distance; twice as far, half as tall. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slides 9–11). A common mistake: Each step farther takes the same amount off the image (a difference, not a ratio).

body.zh: 物高和距离同比放大，像一点不变：一张像只定下物高和距离的比值 H/Z。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 9–11）。常见的误解：物高一样，像就一样高。
body.en: Scale an object's size and distance by the same factor and its image does not change: an image fixes only the ratio H/Z. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slides 9–11). A common mistake: Equal heights give equal images.

body.zh: 图形学由场景生成图像；视觉反过来，从图像推回场景。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲（幻灯片 8）。
body.en: Graphics makes an image from a scene; vision goes the other way, from an image back to a scene. Source: COMP90086 lecture 1 (slide 8).

body.zh: 从图像推回场景时，常有不止一个场景给出同一张图：投影把深度丢掉了。一张图能确定的只是所有相容场景都同意的事；其余要靠另外的线索（已知的物体大小、第二台相机……）。出处：COMP90086 第 1 讲（幻灯片 8）。常见的误解：从像的大小就能读出物体的距离和大小。
body.en: Going from an image back to a scene, more than one scene often gives the same image: projection drops depth. An image settles only what every compatible scene agrees on; the rest needs other cues (a known size, a second camera…). Source: COMP90086 lecture 1 (slide 8). A common mistake: An image's size tells how far and how big the object is.

body.zh: 透镜把一大片光收拢，可只能把一个距离上的点收成点；别的距离上的点落成一块斑。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 12–13）。常见的误解：对焦在两个物体中间，两个都清楚。
body.en: A lens gathers much more light, but brings the points of only one distance to points; points at other distances land as spots. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slides 12–13). A common mistake: Focusing halfway makes both sharp.

body.zh: 离焦的点在传感器上落成一块圆斑；光圈越大，进光越多，这块斑也越大。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 16）。常见的误解：光圈越大越好：只是更亮。
body.en: An out-of-focus point lands on the sensor as a round spot; the wider the aperture, the more light and the bigger the spot. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 16). A common mistake: The wider the better: it is only brighter.

body.zh: 斑小到眼睛（或一个像素）分不出来，就算清楚。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 16）。
body.en: A spot too small for the eye (or a pixel) to tell from a point counts as sharp. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 16).

body.zh: 对焦距离前后，模糊圈还小于容许模糊圈的那一段距离。光圈越小，斑长得越慢，这一段越长，可进光也越少。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 16）。常见的误解：对焦在其中一个物体上、光圈开大，两个都会清晰。
body.en: The range of distances around the focus where the blur circle stays within the acceptable blur. A smaller aperture grows the spot more slowly and lengthens the range, at the cost of light. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 16). A common mistake: Focus on one of them and open the aperture, and both will be sharp.

body.zh: 缩放时，新图每个像素的中心按比例落回原图：新旧两排像素占同样长的一段，新像素中心常落在两个旧像素之间。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 34）。常见的误解：新像素的下标就是原图的下标。
body.en: When resizing, each new pixel's centre maps back into the original in proportion: both rows span the same length, so new centres often fall between old pixels. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 34). A common mistake: A new pixel's index is its place in the original.

body.zh: 每个新像素照抄离它最近的旧像素：快、边缘硬，放大后成块。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 35）。常见的误解：坐标一律向下取整就是最近的那个。
body.en: Each new pixel copies the nearest old pixel: fast and hard-edged, blocky when enlarged. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 35). A common mistake: Rounding every coordinate down picks the nearest pixel.

body.zh: 新像素按它到两个邻居的距离加权：离谁近，谁的份量大；正中间就是两者的平均。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 36）。常见的误解：新像素只能照抄某一个旧像素。
body.en: A new pixel weighs its two neighbours by distance: the nearer counts more; halfway is their average. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 36). A common mistake: A new pixel can only copy an old one.

body.zh: 新像素落在四个旧像素之间时，先横着做两次线性插值，再竖着做一次：四个邻居的加权平均，权重 (1−H)(1−V)、H(1−V)、(1−H)V、HV 加起来是 1。比最近邻平滑，会让锐利的边稍微变软。出处：COMP90086 第 2 讲（幻灯片 36）。常见的误解：只横着插一次就够了。
body.en: A new pixel among four old ones is two linear interpolations across, then one down: a weighted average of the four, the weights (1−H)(1−V), H(1−V), (1−H)V, HV adding to 1. Smoother than nearest neighbour; it softens sharp edges a little. Source: COMP90086 lecture 2 (slide 36). A common mistake: Interpolating across once is enough.

body.zh: 彩色像素的三个数按什么顺序存是约定：OpenCV 读进来的是 B、G、R，Matplotlib 显示时当成 R、G、B，不换就红蓝颠倒。出处：COMP90086 第 2 次 workshop。常见的误解：三个数总是 R、G、B。
body.en: The order a colour pixel's three numbers are stored in is a convention: OpenCV reads B, G, R, Matplotlib shows R, G, B; without a swap red and blue trade places. Source: COMP90086 workshop 2. A common mistake: The three numbers are always R, G, B.
